sentences.text: Court No. - 74 Case :- CRIMINAL MISC ANTICIPATORY BAIL APPLICATION U/S 438 CR.P.C. No. - 13623 of 2023 Applicant :- Shailesh Kumar Ram @ Shailesh Ram Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others Counsel for Applicant :-
Aniruddh Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
1. List revised.
2. No one appears for the applicant to press this anticipatory bail application even when the matter has been taken up in the revised list.
Sri Ajay Singh, learned A.G.A.-I for the State and perused the record.

3. The present anticipatory bail application has been filed by the applicant with the following prayers:-
"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to allow this application and to grant anticipatory bail to the applicants in Case Crime No.132 of 2023, U/s 498A, 304B, 504, 506, 507 I.P.C. & 3/4 D.P. Act P.S.-Karimuddinpur, District-Ghazipur, otherwise the applicant shall suffer irreparable loss and injury."

sentences.text: 4. On 02.01.2024 the following order was passed:-
"1. List revised.
No one appears on behalf of the applicant to press this anticipatory bail application.
Sri Bade Lal Bind, learned counsel for the State is present.
2. Learned counsel for the State states that he has received instructions for which time was granted to him on 08.12.2023.

3. Previously on 16.12.2023 the matter was adjourned on the request of learned counsel for the applicant as per order sheet and the matter was fixed for today as a fresh case.
4.

Since there is no representation on behalf of the applicant, in the interest of justice,
as a last opportunity, the matter is adjourned.

5. Let the matter be listed on 16.01.2024 as fresh."
5.

Since on the last occasion a specific order was passed for adjournment of the matter as a last opportunity as there was no representation from the side of the applicant and the matter was directed to be listed for today and even today there is no representation from the side of the applicant in the revised list.
6.
In view of the same the present anticipatory bail application is dismissed in non-prosecution.

(Samit Gopal,J.) Order Date :- 16.1.2024/Naresh  Shailesh Kumar Ram @ Shailesh Ram vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153452188/
